title: My profile
displayNameHint: The name the members of your campaigns and the people you share a pack with see.
bioPlaceholder: Your play style, your availability, what you enjoy at the table…
bioHint: Optional. Visible to the members of your campaigns ({{length}}/500).

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the interface and of the built-in game content (spells, classes, feats…). What you and your table write stays as written.

account.title: Account and security
account.description: Every change asks for your current password.

password.title: Password
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

email.title: Email address
email.current: Current: {{email}}. A confirmation link goes to the new address; it only replaces the old one once the link is followed.
email.sent: Link sent to {{email}}: open it to confirm the change.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.warning: Your characters, your drafts and the packs you own are deleted, and you leave your campaigns. Packs a campaign has copied stay there. This cannot be undone.
delete.stillGm_one: You are the Game Master of this campaign: delete it first.
delete.stillGm_other: You are the Game Master of these campaigns: delete them first.
delete.stillGmToast: You are still the Game Master of a campaign.

storage.title: Image storage
storage.description: Link your Dropbox: wherever the app asks for an image link (map, portrait, handout), you can import a file from your device. It goes into the app's folder in your Dropbox and is shared by link.
storage.disconnected: Dropbox disconnected. Images already imported stay online.
storage.privacy: Imported images are public to anyone with the link, like a Dropbox share link. The app only reaches its own folder.
